{"parentUuid":"ea7ebed2-ef62-492a-b31c-564e67b90293","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfmT56e1boLZW8ahwYQ6M","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Wqqr5wc5B2UQD5fWm4dDky","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/console.py","old_string":"\"\"\"Staff console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\nContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below, an Ambassador sees the pre-T08 stub screen\nuntil \"My posts\" (T08, #9) replaces it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in SIDEBAR],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None or user.role != \"admin\":\n        # Anonymous, or an Ambassador whose own landing screen (\"My posts\")\n        # is T08's job, not this ticket's.\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)","new_string":"\"\"\"Staff console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\nContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics. Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\nthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n    }\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2148,"cache_read_input_tokens":88960,"output_tokens":2510,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2148,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2510,"cache_read_input_tokens":88960,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2148,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2148},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01Wqqr5wc5B2UQD5fWm4dDky":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/console.py","old_string":"\"\"\"Staff and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n    }\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)"}},"apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfmT56Ne3jnURY9kQSyUe","type":"assistant","uuid":"901ca3a4-a786-4ac0-95a0-56e3e3ec534a","timestamp":"2026-10-06T18:23:47.731Z","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"fe076a3d-36e9-4a30-a2ce-a40151603299","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSECRET = re.compile(r\"(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN\\s*[:=]\\s*\\S{8,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY)\")\nREPORT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nTRANSCRIPT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_\\d{2}_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nSCREENS = [\"login\", \"dashboard\", \"content-list\", \"editor\", \"users\", \"editor-denied\"]\n\n\ndef sh(*args: str) -> str:\n    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout\n\n\nclass Checks:\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.results: list[dict] = []\n\n    def add(self, ok: bool, name: str, detail: str, fix: str = \"\") -> None:\n        self.results.append({\"check\": name, \"ok\": bool(ok), \"detail\": detail, \"fix\": fix})\n\n    # --- checks -----------------------------------------------------------\n    def hygiene(self) -> None:\n        tracked = sh(\"git\", \"ls-files\").splitlines()\n        bad = [f for f in tracked if f.endswith((\".db\", \".env\")) or f.startswith(\".claude/state/\")]\n        self.add(not bad, \"no database or .env committed\", \", \".join(bad) or \"clean\",\n                 \"git rm --cached <file>, confirm .gitignore covers it, then rewrite history if it is old\")\n        history = sh(\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"-p\", \"--\", \".\")\n        hits = sorted(set(SECRET.findall(history)))\n        self.add(not hits, \"no secrets in history\", f\"{len(hits)} match(es)\",\n                 \"rotate the key first, then ask Claude to rewrite history\")\n        self.add((ROOT / \".env.example\").exists(), \".env.example present\", \"\", \"restore it from the template\")\n\n    def docs(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        pairs = [\n            (\"notes/cms-field-notes.md\", \"field notes\"),\n            (\"CONTEXT.md\", \"glossary\"),\n            (\"notes/token-budget-plan.md\", \"token budget plan\"),\n            (\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\", \"usage ledger\"),\n            (\"docs/process/compaction-log.md\", \"compaction log\"),\n        ]\n        if stage >= 2:\n            pairs += [(\"README.md\", \"README\"), (\"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \"seed script\")]\n        for path, label in pairs:\n            self.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"{label} present\", path, f\"create {path}\")\n        if stage >= 2:\n            handoffs = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"handoff\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n            self.add(bool(handoffs), \"at least one handoff saved\", f\"{len(handoffs)} file(s)\",\n                     \"copy a /handoff document into docs/handoff/\")\n\n    def naming(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        reports = list((ROOT / \"docs\").glob(\"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_*.md\"))\n        if stage >= 2:\n            ok = any(REPORT.match(p.name) for p in reports)\n            self.add(ok, \"report named correctly\",\n                     \", \".join(p.name for p in reports) or \"missing\",\n                     \"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, lowercase\")\n        transcripts = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"transcripts\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n        bad = [p.name for p in transcripts if not TRANSCRIPT.match(p.name)]\n        self.add(transcripts and not bad, \"transcripts present and named correctly\",\n                 f\"{len(transcripts)} file(s); bad: {bad or 'none'}\",\n                 \"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{NN}_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md\")\n\n    def readme(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        text = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text() if (ROOT / \"README.md\").exists() else \"\"\n        for needle, label in [(\"http\", \"live URL\"), (\"Run locally\", \"run-locally section\"),\n                              (\"Generative AI Use Statement\", \"AI Use Statement\")]:\n            self.add(needle.lower() in text.lower(), f\"README has {label}\", \"\",\n                     f\"add the {label} to README.md\")\n        placeholder = \"*(Required. Replace this section\" in text\n        self.add(not placeholder, \"AI Use Statement was rewritten\", \"\",\n                 \"replace the template placeholder with your own statement\")\n\n    def screenshots(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        files = {p.name.lower() for p in (ROOT / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\").glob(\"*\")}\n        missing = [f\"{s}-{w}\" for s in SCREENS for w in (1280, 390)\n                   if not any(s in n and str(w) in n for n in files)]\n        self.add(not missing, \"12 screenshots present\", \", \".join(missing) or \"all present\",\n                 \"docs/screenshots/{screen}-{1280|390}.png for each of: \" + \", \".join(SCREENS))\n\n    def git_state(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        tags = sh(\"git\", \"tag\").split()\n        want = [\"mp2-mvp\"] + ([\"mp2-final\"] if stage >= 2 else [])\n        for tag in want:\n            self.add(tag in tags, f\"tag {tag} exists\", \", \".join(tags) or \"none\",\n                     f\"git tag {tag} && git push --tags\")\n        paths = sh(\"git\", \"grep\", \"-l\", '-e', 'href=\"/', \"-e\", 'src=\"/', \"--\", \"*.html\")\n        self.add(not paths.strip(), \"no root-absolute paths in HTML\", paths.strip() or \"clean\",\n                 'use relative paths (\"style.css\"), not \"/style.css\"')\n\n    def tests(self) -> None:\n        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pytest\", \"-q\"], cwd=ROOT,\n                             capture_output=True, text=True)\n        self.add(run.returncode == 0, \"test suite passes\",\n                 run.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if run.stdout else \"\",\n                 \"fix failing tests before submitting\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--stage\", type=int, choices=[0, 1, 2], default=2)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--json\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    c = Checks()\n    c.hygiene()\n    if args.stage == 0:\n        for path in [\"app/main.py\", \"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \".claude/settings.json\",\n                     \"CLAUDE.md\", \"SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md\"]:\n            c.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"template file {path}\", \"\", \"restore from the dev repo\")\n    else:\n        c.docs(args.stage)\n        c.naming(args.stage)\n        c.readme(args.stage)\n        c.screenshots(args.stage)\n        c.git_state(args.stage)\n        c.tests()\n\n    failures = [r for r in c.results if not r[\"ok\"]]\n    if args.json:\n        print(json.dumps({\"stage\": args.stage, \"failures\": len(failures),\n                          \"results\": c.results}, indent=2))\n    else:\n        for r in c.results:\n            print(f\"{'PASS' if r['ok'] else 'FAIL'}  {r['check']}\"\n                  + (f\"  [{r['detail']}]\" if r[\"detail\"] else \"\"))\n            if not r[\"ok\"] and r[\"fix\"]:\n                print(f\"      fix: {r['fix']}\")\n        print(f\"\\n{len(c.results) - len(failures)}/{len(c.results)} checks passed.\")\n    return 1 if failures else 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\nthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n    }\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    posts = models.list_all_posts()\n    status_counts = {status: 0 for status in STATUS_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        status_counts[post.status] += 1\n\n    level_counts: dict[int, int] = {}\n    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n        level = len(models.list_ancestors(page))\n        level_counts[level] = level_counts.get(level, 0) + 1\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Dashboard\",\n        \"status_counts\": [(status, status_counts[status]) for status in STATUS_CHOICES],\n        \"level_counts\": sorted(level_counts.items()),\n        \"active_accounts\": sum(1 for u in models.list_users() if u.active),\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/content\")\ndef content_list(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    status: str = \"\",\n    kind: str = \"\",\n):\n    items = []\n    if kind in (\"\", \"page\"):\n        for page in models.list_all_pages():\n            if status and page.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Page\", \"title\": page.title, \"status\": page.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n            })\n    if kind in (\"\", \"post\"):\n        for post in models.list_all_posts():\n            if status and post.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Post\", \"title\": post.title, \"status\": post.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n            })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Content list\",\n        \"items\": items,\n        \"status_choices\": STATUS_CHOICES,\n        \"type_choices\": TYPE_CHOICES,\n        \"status_filter\": status,\n        \"kind_filter\": kind,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/content_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pending\")\ndef pending_queue(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    pending = sorted(\n        (p for p in models.list_all_posts() if p.status == \"pending\"),\n        key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n    )\n    rows = []\n    for post in pending:\n        author = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n        rows.append({\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"author_name\": author.display_name if author else \"Unknown\",\n            \"submitted_date\": (post.updated_at or \"\")[:10],\n            \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n        })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Pending queue\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/pending_queue.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/metrics\")\ndef metrics(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    programs = [p for p in models.list_all_pages() if models.is_program_page(p)]\n    rows = sorted(\n        (\n            {\"program\": program, \"count\": len(models.list_posts_by_program(program.id))}\n            for program in programs\n        ),\n        key=lambda row: row[\"program\"].title,\n    )\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Metrics\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/metrics.html\", console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\nContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics. Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\nthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n    }\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    posts = models.list_all_posts()\n    status_counts = {status: 0 for status in STATUS_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        status_counts[post.status] += 1\n\n    level_counts: dict[int, int] = {}\n    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n        level = len(models.list_ancestors(page))\n        level_counts[level] = level_counts.get(level, 0) + 1\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Dashboard\",\n        \"status_counts\": [(status, status_counts[status]) for status in STATUS_CHOICES],\n        \"level_counts\": sorted(level_counts.items()),\n        \"active_accounts\": sum(1 for u in models.list_users() if u.active),\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/content\")\ndef content_list(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    status: str = \"\",\n    kind: str = \"\",\n):\n    items = []\n    if kind in (\"\", \"page\"):\n        for page in models.list_all_pages():\n            if status and page.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Page\", \"title\": page.title, \"status\": page.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n            })\n    if kind in (\"\", \"post\"):\n        for post in models.list_all_posts():\n            if status and post.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Post\", \"title\": post.title, \"status\": post.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n            })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Content list\",\n        \"items\": items,\n        \"status_choices\": STATUS_CHOICES,\n        \"type_choices\": TYPE_CHOICES,\n        \"status_filter\": status,\n        \"kind_filter\": kind,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/content_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pending\")\ndef pending_queue(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    pending = sorted(\n        (p for p in models.list_all_posts() if p.status == \"pending\"),\n        key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n    )\n    rows = []\n    for post in pending:\n        author = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n        rows.append({\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"author_name\": author.display_name if author else \"Unknown\",\n            \"submitted_date\": (post.updated_at or \"\")[:10],\n            \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n        })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Pending queue\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/pending_queue.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/metrics\")\ndef metrics(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    programs = [p for p in models.list_all_pages() if models.is_program_page(p)]\n    rows = sorted(\n        (\n            {\"program\": program, \"count\": len(models.list_posts_by_program(program.id))}\n            for program in programs\n        ),\n        key=lambda row: row[\"program\"].title,\n    )\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Metrics\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/metrics.html\", context)\n","numLines":198,"startLine":1,"totalLines":198}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7b482bd8-e365-4ffc-b230-b1ba0f6c1442","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"fe076a3d-36e9-4a30-a2ce-a40151603299","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

page\nhierarchy, metrics.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import models\n\n\ndef _seed_program(author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id)\n\n\n# --- Landing screen (GET /admin) --------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_staff_landing_is_a_live_preview_of_the_published_site(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    models.publish_page(program.parent_id)\n    models.publish_page(models.get_page_by_id(program.parent_id).parent_id)\n\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"staff demo\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"live preview\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"Asia\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_landing_is_unchanged(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"ambassador demo\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"live preview\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# --- Dashboard ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_shows_post_and_page_and_account_counts(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"Draft Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", admin.id)\n    pending = models.create_post(program.id, \"Pending Post\", \"body\", \"meals\", admin.id)\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"draft: 1\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"pending: 1\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"published: 0\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"2 active account\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert draft.id and pending.id  # posts were created under the seeded program\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_pages_by_level(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    # Home (level 0), Asia (level 1), Japan (level 2), Kyoto Exchange (level 3).\n    assert \"home: 1\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"level 1: 1\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"level 2: 1\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"level 3: 1\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# --- Content list -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_posts_and_pages_together(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    models.create_post(program.id, models.create_post(program.id, \"My Published\", \"body\", \"academics\", editor.id)\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n Ownership isolation is enforced at two independent layers (SQL query in `models.list_posts_by_author`, and route-level `_authorize_post_write`/`review_gate` checks in `app/routes/posts.py`), so even if the view template were wrong, an Ambassador couldn't actually touch another user's post. All 15 new/updated tests plus the full 150-test suite pass. No literal `href=\"/...` or `src=\"/...` was introduced (`templates/admin/my_posts.html` only uses Jinja-computed hrefs).\n\n## Acceptance criteria — all met\n- Sidebar: `EDITOR_SIDEBAR = [(\"/admin\", \"My posts\")]` (app/routes/console.py:42-44) + the \"Log out\" form baked into `console_base.html` — nothing else, confirmed by `test_ambassador_sidebar_is_only_my_posts_and_logout`.\n- Grouped listing by status, own posts only: `_my_posts_response` (console.py:55-85) iterates `STATUS_CHOICES` and filters `own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)`.\n- Staff routes admin-only: unchanged `Depends(require_admin)` on dashboard/content/pending/metrics, confirmed by `test_ambassador_cannot_reach_any_staff_console_route`. Pages/Accounts routers already admin-gated elsewhere.\n- Staff landing untouched: `test_staff_landing_still_shows_live_preview_not_my_posts` passes.\n- Seed script criterion: covered by `test_seed_demo_editor_has_a_post_in_every_status`, and the ticket states this file wasn't modified — confirmed, diff doesn't touch `scripts/seed_demo.py`.\n\n## Things I checked specifically for authz bugs (none found)\n- `available_actions(status, user.role, True)` is called with `is_author` hardcoded `True` — safe only because the row is always drawn from the user's own `own_posts`, so this is correct, not a shortcut that leaks.\n- Published-row actions correctly render empty for an editor (`(\"published\",\"unpublish\")` rule requires `role == \"admin\"`), so no stray \"Unpublish\" button appears for an Ambassador.\n- Even if the template were compromised/misrendered to show someone else's post with action buttons, POSTing to `/admin/posts/{id}/submit|publish|bounce|unpublish|delete|edit` re-checks ownership server-side (`_authorize_post_write`, `_apply_transition`) — defense in depth is real, not just UI-level hiding.\n\n## Minor/non-blocking observations (style, not bugs)\n1. **N+1 page lookup**: `_my_posts_response` calls `models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)` once per post in a loop (console.py:69). For a student project with small seed data this is harmless, but it's the one place worth a comment if a reviewer wanted a \"future cleanup\" note — not worth blocking on.\n2. **Docstring says \"edit/delete links only render there [draft]\"** — accurate, but worth noting `can_edit` gates *both* edit and delete hrefs with a single flag name that only mentions edit; a future reader skimming the template might wonder why delete is also inside the `can_edit` block. Purely a naming nit (`templates/admin/my_posts.html:11-14`).\n3. `STATUS_CHOICES` is now reused across both the Staff dashboard/content-list code and the Ambassador grouping — good reuse, no duplication introduced.\n4. The removed test `test_ambassador_landing_is_unchanged` in `tests/test_t07.py` is correctly deleted since T08 intentionally supersedes that stub behavior; nothing else in the T07 test file was touched per the diff.\n\nNo correctness, authorization, or spec-compliance bugs found. The diff is ready as-is.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>51623</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>16</tool_uses><duration_ms>113704</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}
